6.92 rsInvalidNumberOfFilterValues
rsInvalidNumberOfFilterValues is a critical error that will occur when a Filter element contains an
incorrect number of FilterValues.FilterValue elements for a particular Filter.Operator value. For
example, if Filter.Operator is set to "Equal", and there exist two FilterValues.FilterValue instances
for that Filter, this error will occur.
